description: This file defines the 'Session' struct and related functions for managing lease-based sessions in etcd's concurrency package, including session creation, renewal, orphaning, and revocation.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a lease session with methods to manage its lifecycle, including renewal, orphaning, and closing.

methods.name: NewSession
methods.description: Creates a new lease session for a given etcd client, optionally with custom options.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Returns the etcd client associated with the session.

methods.name: Lease
methods.description: Returns the lease ID associated with the session.

methods.name: Ctx
methods.description: Returns the context associated with the session, which is canceled when the lease expires or is orphaned.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Returns a channel that closes when the lease is no longer active.

methods.name: Orphan
methods.description: Ends the lease refresh, effectively orphaning the lease.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Orphans the session and revokes the lease.

methods.name: WithTTL
methods.description: Configures the TTL (time-to-live) for the session.

methods.name: WithLease
methods.description: Specifies an existing lease ID to be used for the session.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Assigns a custom context to the session, useful for immediate cancellation.
